P01.rationale: There is no large dominant founder portrait anchoring the page; the only human images are small testimonial cards and reference thumbnails at the bottom.

P05.rationale: The two testimonial cards each contain a small portrait, but they are quite small relative to the card size and far below a quarter-to-third column proportion.

P07.rationale: A social-proof section ('Das sagen unsere Kunden') with testimonial cards and a reference logo/photo strip is present, forming a recognisable proof apparatus.

P10.rationale: The 'In Zahlen' sidebar uses large bold numerals (100+, €200k+, 30-50%) but they function as data callouts rather than purely decorative ghost/oversized typographic elements.

P11.rationale: The 'In Zahlen' panel presents three concrete metrics with labels, acting as a before/after data summary bound to real numbers, though no chart or visual graph is used.

P12.rationale: The page is reasonably well-filled with a headline block, body copy, stats panel, testimonial cards, and a reference strip, giving a moderately dense editorial feel.

P13.rationale: The background has a very subtle warm paper-like texture, but it is barely perceptible and contributes minimally to atmospheric depth.

P14.rationale: The reference strip photos at the bottom have no overlaid text, and the testimonial card photos are contained within framed cards, so legibility is maintained without needing scrims.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The testimonial cards and reference photos appear to show real named clients with logos, reducing generic stock feel, though the reference strip images look somewhat generic in framing.

N08.rationale: There is a noticeable empty gap in the lower-left area beside the testimonial cards, and the body-copy column has some loose whitespace, but it is not severely under-filled.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over busy photos without protection; all text sits on clean backgrounds or within framed card areas.
